context: The agent must replace example.md's placeholder ('TODO: fill in from the ADR.') with a body composed from ADR-0099's ## Decision section (a lead sentence plus a 'The rules:' numbered list of three items). Key discriminator: a generic agent asked to 'fill in' a TODO from a linked ADR can plausibly write something reasonable, but without the skill's explicit extraction discipline it tends to either under-cover the numbered list's specific points (oldest-first tracking, size is never a signal, cache hits don't refresh age) or pad the body with material from ## Context / ## Consequences that isn't part of the normative Decision.

checklist.name: Placeholder removed
checklist.description: The body no longer contains 'TODO' or any placeholder text

checklist.name: Covers oldest-first eviction
checklist.description: States that the oldest entry is evicted first when the cache is full (insertion order tracked per entry)

checklist.name: Covers size is never a signal
checklist.description: States that eviction never considers entry size

checklist.name: Covers cache hits don't refresh age
checklist.description: States that a cache hit does not reset or refresh an entry's age for eviction purposes

checklist.name: No content beyond the Decision section
checklist.description: The body introduces no claim from ## Context (e.g. the size-first rationale discussion) or ## Consequences (e.g. the easier/harder tradeoffs) — only the Decision's lead and rule list

checklist.name: Heading and See-line unchanged
checklist.description: The section heading ('## Evict widgets oldest-first') and the trailing See [...] line are byte-identical to the original
